# GET : getReturnPolicies Samples

**API Type:** REST
**Operation:** GET `/sell/metadata/v1/marketplace/{marketplace_id}/get_return_policies`
**Base URL:** `https://api.ebay.com`

## Description

This method retrieves return policy metadata for the specified marketplace.

## Request

```http
GET https://api.ebay.com/sell/metadata/v1/marketplace/{marketplace_id}/get_return_policies
```

## Response

A successful request returns HTTP `200`.

Note: The bundled doc page for this operation does not include a concrete JSON response example.
